title: The one-way commute
explanation: The fix names the criteria (cost, time, safety in the rain), asks for a table, and asks for one pick with one reason. Options A and C ask for honesty or length, but never say what 'best' means.
brokenPrompt: Which is the best way to get to school: bike, bus, or walking?
brokenOutput: Biking is the best way to get to school. It is fast, healthy, and fun.

diagnoses.text: The assistant should not give opinions.
'Best' was never defined, so the assistant picked its own reason.

wrongDiagnosisHint: Best for what? Check whether the order says.
rightDiagnosisNote: 'Best' depends on what matters to you. With no criteria, the assistant chose its own: speed and fun.

fixes.prompt: Which is really the best way to get to school: bike, bus, or walking? Be honest.
Compare bike, bus, and walking for getting to school on cost, time, and safety in the rain. Use a table with low, medium, or high. Then recommend one and give one reason.
Which is the best way to get to school? Give me a long, detailed answer about all three.

wrongFixHint: Honesty and length do not define 'best'. Pick the one that names the criteria.
fixedOutput:
| Option | Cost | Time | Safe in rain |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bike | Low | Low | Low |
| Bus | Medium | Medium | High |
| Walk | Low | High | Medium |
I recommend the bus for rainy days. It keeps you dry, and the cost stays medium.
